# FaradayDesk

> A human-led decision stress-testing desk for Bitget stock-token spot positions. Private notes stay in the browser; public evidence, deterministic arithmetic and AI interpretation are kept separate and each is sourced.

FaradayDesk calculates hypothetical loss for an unleveraged long spot position, retrieves observed weekend trading history for Bitget stock tokens, and asks a language model to challenge a stated thesis using only supplied, sourced context. It places no orders, connects to no account and holds no funds.

## How to read the figures

- Weekend window: Saturday 00:00 UTC to Monday 00:00 UTC, measured from twelve consecutive four-hour stock-token candles. This is not the US cash-market Friday-close to Monday-open gap.
- Earnings window: the 24 hours beginning with the 20:00 UTC candle on a dated company results release, which contains a post-close US release under both daylight-saving regimes.
- Inflation window: the 24 hours beginning with the 12:00 UTC candle on a dated US CPI release, which contains an 08:30 ET release under both daylight-saving regimes.
- A window follows a release; it does not isolate its effect. No other driver is controlled for and there is no abnormal-return model.
- End return compares the Saturday opening price with the final Sunday candle close. Decline to low compares the Saturday opening price with the lowest candle low inside the window.
- A weekend with any missing or zero-volume candle is excluded whole, and the count of exclusions is always reported.
- Percentiles and shock comparisons are withheld below eight complete windows. Samples are small either way.
- Figures are observations of one venue's token trading. They are not underlying equity returns, matched macro events, probabilities, forecasts or recommendations.
- Loss = notional x (adverse move + assumed costs) / 100. The adverse move is chosen by the user, not predicted.

## Public endpoints

Read-only, no key required, rate limited per address. Please cache responses; the weekend history is recalculated at most hourly per instrument.

- GET /api/market?asset=NVDA|TSLA|AAPL — validated spot snapshot: last, bid, ask, spread, twenty-level displayed depth, source timestamps. Stale, crossed or malformed books fail closed with HTTP 503 rather than returning a partial quote.
- GET /api/history?lens=weekend|earnings|inflation&asset=NVDA|TSLA|AAPL — observed windows for that lens: dated windows with their primary sources, sample size, exclusions, and percentiles when at least eight windows are complete. The weekend lens covers the preceding 84 days; the event lenses cover up to the twelve most recent dated releases.
- GET /api/research — whether cloud AI is configured. The research POST itself is interactive, shares a capped allowance and is not for automated use.
- GET /healthz — service health.

## Instruments

NVDA maps to RNVDAUSDT, TSLA to RTSLAUSDT, AAPL to RAAPLUSDT, all Bitget SPOT stock tokens quoted in USDT. Listing metadata is re-verified on every fetch; it does not establish issuer reserves, redemption rights or USDT parity.

## Sources

- Source and methodology: https://github.com/0xileri/FaradayDesk
